label: 📡 Sensor Traffic Storm
info: Simulates heavy incoming sensor traffic: LiDAR at 20Hz, Camera at 30fps, Odometry at 50Hz (~100 msgs/sec total).

label: ⚠️ False Obstacle Alerts
info: Four false-obstacle test scenarios: single close obstacle, burst of 5 simultaneous, flickering sensor artifact, approaching obstacle with decreasing range.

label: 🛰️ Telemetry & Battery
info: GPS telemetry along a Gwanda→homestead delivery route and battery drain model with RTH failsafe at 25%.

── Scenario C ── Flickering sensor artifact at 100ms (auto repeat)
info: Alternates DETECTED/CLEAR every 100ms simulating a faulty LiDAR return. Tests hysteresis/debounce filter in obstacle_monitor.py.

info: Range decreases 0.15m every 200ms. Routes GREEN→AMBER→RED through switch node and resets automatically at 0.3m.
